heading: INT. MOREAU CONSERVATORY OF GLASS - OBSERVATION GALLERY - NIGHT

units.text: INT. MOREAU CONSERVATORY OF GLASS - OBSERVATION GALLERY - NIGHT
A great glass dome shelters a jungle of tropical plants.
Above, rain on the panes.
Below, a long dining table laid with candles, crystal, and silver, at which six guests have gathered for a gala dinner.
CALISTA MOREAU, 50s, the hostess, in a ruby gown, presides at the head.
BARTHOLOMEW "BART" QUINCE, 60s, the collector, red-faced and jovial, sits at her right.
NAVEEN RAO, 40s, the insurance assessor, taps a pen against his wine glass.
LUDMILA, 30s, a violinist, waits in her chair with the instrument in her lap.
FERRIS, 40s, the butler, stands behind with a silver tray.
ZHOU MEI, 30s, a restorer, studies the centerpiece, a small bronze sculpture on a pedestal of black marble.
Ladies and gentlemen. Dinner.
units.name: CALISTA

units.text: At last.
units.name: BART

units.text: Before we eat, Mrs. Moreau, I'd like to confirm the sculpture's appraisal.
units.name: NAVEEN

units.text: Four million.
units.name: CALISTA

units.text: Four and a half, I believe, by the last estimate.
units.name: NAVEEN

units.text: You are very precise.
units.name: CALISTA

units.text: It is my profession.
units.name: NAVEEN

units.text: It's very beautiful.
units.name: ZHOU MEI

units.text: It is a fraud.
units.name: BART

units.text: Excuse me?
units.name: LUDMILA

units.text: The original is in a private vault in Zurich. I bought it myself. This is the copy.
units.name: BART

units.text: You are wrong, Bartholomew.
units.name: CALISTA

units.text: I am never wrong about bronzes.
units.name: BART

units.text: Shall I pour, madam?
units.name: FERRIS

units.text: Please.
units.name: CALISTA

units.text: Very good.
units.name: FERRIS

units.text: If it is a copy, the insurance is void.
units.name: NAVEEN

units.text: It is not a copy.
units.name: ZHOU MEI

units.text: How would you know?
units.name: NAVEEN

units.text: I restored it. I know every scratch.
units.name: ZHOU MEI

units.text: Then you are in on it.
units.name: BART

units.text: I am not in on anything.
units.name: ZHOU MEI

units.text: Someone play me a waltz. This is unbearable.
units.name: LUDMILA

units.text: Ludmila, hush. Zhou Mei, if you restored it, what did you find on the base?
units.name: CALISTA

units.text: A maker's mark. Three letters.
units.name: ZHOU MEI

units.text: And what were they?
units.name: CALISTA

units.text: C. M. R.
units.name: ZHOU MEI

units.text: Calista Moreau, Restorer. My own mark.
units.name: CALISTA

units.text: You made it. Yourself.
units.name: BART

units.text: Thirty years ago. In this conservatory.
units.name: CALISTA

units.text: Mrs. Moreau, do you understand what you're saying?
units.name: NAVEEN

units.text: Perfectly. The Zurich bronze is the forgery, Bartholomew.
units.name: CALISTA

units.text: Bart stands.
His chair crashes behind him.
You sold me a fake.
units.name: BART

units.text: Forty years ago. For a very good price.
units.name: CALISTA

units.text: Shall I call the police, madam?
units.name: FERRIS

units.text: Not yet, Ferris. Pour the wine.
units.name: CALISTA
